newsitem.title: USA: Deposit Guaranty to acquire Citisave.
newsitem.headline: Deposit Guaranty to acquire Citisave.

text.p: Deposit Guaranty Corp and CitiSave Financial Corp said on Wednesday that Deposit Guaranty has agreed to acquire CitiSave for $20.50 a share in cash, or a total of $21.4 million.
CitiSave has six offices in Baton Rouge and $75 million in assets, including $45.2 million in loans, the companies said in a joint statement.
The company will become a part of Deposit Guaranty's existing south Louisiana banking operation later this year.
The acquisition of Citizens Savings will continue Deposit Guaranty's expansion in the Baton Rouge market, the companies said.
Deposit Guaranty is a multibank holding company based in Jackson, Miss., with total assets of $6.4 billion as of Dec. 31, 1996.
